But also: no criminalisation, functioning courts, hate crime protection for gender reassignment, LGBT acceptance in society, large communities. The Joelle case: denied cancer ward care → death. That's severe (denial of life-saving care). This is tier 1 with documented enforcement. Rule 11: liability clause fully — efficient enforcement of hostile policy is exposure.
